verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing describes built-in AI assistants that do employees' expenses for them: writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help and filing reimbursements. It also describes in-product review and audit agents that auto-approve, escalate and categorize spend, and Brex AI that drafts bill payments, so tasks can be handed to native AI. The MCP server is an external-agent interface and is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how users direct or converse with the assistant (e.g., natural-language task requests), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the assistant works as claimed.
